title: Catalog

hints.branch: Branch staff can only pick their own branch. A document in the hierarchy takes its branch from the fund.
hints.slug: Latin letters, digits and hyphens. A published object's address cannot change.

files.title: Files
files.hint: PDF, JPG/PNG/WebP/TIFF, audio and video. The type is checked by content. A new file stays closed (“Needs review”) until you set its access.
files.deleteText: The file “{name}” will be deleted permanently.

coords.title: Coordinates
coords.hint: Click the map to place the point or enter values. Latitude and longitude are set together.

exhibits.title: Exhibits
exhibits.description: Change the order by dragging or with the buttons. Each exhibit is published through approval.
exhibits.deleteText: The exhibit “{name}” will be deleted permanently.

errors.version_conflict: The object was changed by someone else. Reload the form; unsaved edits will be lost.
errors.invalid_range: The start date is later than the end date.
errors.duplicate_number: An object with this number already exists here.
errors.not_deletable: Only a draft or archived object can be deleted.
errors.branch_locked: The branch of a fund with inventories cannot be changed.
errors.slug_locked: A published object's address cannot change.
errors.file_not_owned: The file does not belong to this object.
errors.unknown_link: Linked document or fund not found.
errors.invalid_order: The exhibit list is out of date. Reload the page.
errors.unsupported_file_type: File type is not supported or does not match the extension.
errors.invalid_file: The file is damaged or empty.
errors.invalid_transition: This transition is not available now.

branches.title: Branches
branches.lead: Contacts, opening hours, coordinates and a photo of the building. Changes reach the site after approval.
branches.leadScoped: You see only your own branch. Changes reach the site after approval.

exhibitions.title: Exhibitions and exhibits
exhibitions.lead: An exhibition consists of exhibits. The icon in a row opens the exhibit list, where you add and order them.
exhibitions.empty: Create the first exhibition and add exhibits.

lead: A fund holds inventories, an inventory holds cases, a case holds documents. Click a title to open nested records; the pencil icon opens the card.

createInside.inventory: A new inventory is created inside a fund: open a fund on the “Funds” tab.
createInside.case: A new case is created inside an inventory: open a fund, then an inventory.
createInside.document: A new document is created inside a case: open a fund, an inventory and a case.

emptyHint.fund: Create the first fund or load descriptions under “Import and export”.
